extDescription.message: Pick the tabs to save from the toolbar, reopen them anytime, and keep an automatic backup file in Downloads. No account needed.

optionsIncludePinnedDesc.message: When off, pinned tabs stay open when you save a window. Right-click send always sends that tab.

optionsRemoveAfterRestoreTitle.message: Remove reopened tabs from the list

optionsRemoveAfterRestoreDesc.message: When off, tabs stay in your saved list after you open them.

optionsBackupRecoverHint.message: You can recover from this file even after resetting the browser.

optionsBackupStatusOk.message: Last saved $1 · You can recover from this file even after resetting the browser.

optionsBackupStatusPending.message: Save pending ($1) · You can recover from this file even after resetting the browser.

optionsBackupStatusPendingNever.message: Save pending · You can recover from this file even after resetting the browser.

optionsBackupStatusWriting.message: Saving · You can recover from this file even after resetting the browser.

optionsBackupStatusFailed.message: Save failed: $1 · You can recover from this file even after resetting the browser.

optionsBackupStatusPaused.message: Paused because the download was canceled. Use Back up now to resume.

optionsBackupStatusNever.message: No backup file yet · You can recover from this file even after resetting the browser.

optionsBackupFolderDesc.message: Created inside your Downloads folder with this name.

optionsBackupIntervalDesc.message: Use a longer delay if you move tabs often so files are written less often.

optionsDedupeDesc.message: Tabs with the same URL as one you already saved are not imported.

optionsShortcutTitle.message: Save this window's tabs right away

optionsShortcutDesc.message: Saves without asking you to pick tabs.

optionsShortcutFirefoxHint.message: Change it in Add-ons Manager → gear menu → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

optionsShortcutFallbackHint.message: Open your browser's extension shortcut settings to change this shortcut.

optionsDeleteDesc.message: This cannot be undone. Backup files in Downloads are not deleted.

deleteAllConfirm.message: Delete saved tabs, settings, undo, and in-browser snapshots? Backup files in Downloads will remain.

backupFilePaused.message: File backup paused: the download was canceled. Use Back up now to resume.

backupRestoreHint.message: Choose tabbunker-latest.json or a dated file in the TabBunker folder inside Downloads.

backupErrAccess.message: The browser could not write the file.

backupErrName.message: The backup folder name cannot be used. Check Settings.

backupErrUnknown.message: The download failed. You can also save a copy with Export.

backupCleanupFailed.message: Some older dated backup files could not be removed. New dated files are paused until cleanup succeeds.

backupDatedFailed.message: The dated backup file could not be saved. The latest file is fine.

backupTimeout.message: Still saving. Check again in a moment.

collapseCount.message: Save and close tabs in this window ($1)

collapseExcludedSystem.message: $1 browser or extension pages are excluded.

collapseExcludedBoth.message: $1 pinned tabs and $2 browser or extension pages are excluded.

collapseEmpty.message: No tabs to save in this window.

undoUnavailable.message: Later edits prevent this undo. Use Open instead.

restoreFailedSome.message: Could not open: $1. Those links stay in the group.

importMergeImpact.message: Merge adds new groups: $1, new links: $2. Duplicates skipped: $3.

importReplaceImpact.message: Replace all moves to Trash: $1. Locked and kept: $2. Added: $3.

staleEdit.message: This group changed elsewhere. The list was reloaded. Try again.

ctxSendWindow.message: Send all tabs in this window

reviewPromptBody.message: Has TabBunker been useful? A short review on the store helps other people find it.

popupHint.message: Saved tabs can be reopened from the Vault at any time.

popupExcludedSystem.message: $1 browser or extension pages are excluded.

popupExcludedBoth.message: $1 pinned tabs and $2 browser or extension pages are excluded.

undoKeepDone.message: Save undone. Tabs were not closed.

popupEmptyBody.message: Saved tabs gather here, ready to reopen anytime.

popupBackupNotice.message: When you save tabs, a backup file is written to the TabBunker folder in Downloads automatically, so you can recover even after resetting the browser.

popupBackupNoticeFirefox.message: In Firefox, the downloads list may open briefly when the file is saved.

vaultEmptyBody.message: Click the TabBunker icon in the toolbar to pick tabs from this window to save. If you do not see the icon, pin TabBunker from the puzzle-shaped extensions menu.
